source: Own measurement, 2026-11-24, NATIVE and OUTSIDE THE ENGINE: it has to be measured again through `ale validate` before the task is merged. The privileged reference (solution/solve.sh, token truth) was run through this folder's verify stage (tests/verify.py as an ordinary account, the kit's Solver and probe lock, one fresh cell process per pack) on the fixed hidden set (tests/hidden/packs.json, six packs) in the author's Isaac Sim 6.2.0.0 / Isaac Lab 3.0.0 environment on the author's server (RTX 6000 Ada, driver 570, PhysX on the CPU), on the tree of commit 230187b: mean_pack_credit 1.00000 (every pack 1.0: 49, 48, 59, 58, 67 and 69 of their items placed), no protective stop, probe pairs 77 of 77 differing (50 idle pairs not counted), 852 to 1185 steps and 601 to 813 s of simulated time per pack, the reference's own time 6 s, the stage 1166 s. No Docker on that server: the image was never built, the cell never ran as its own account, and no engine gate has run. Two repeats on the tree of 21ac344 (the same cell, grader and reference) gave the same value step for step, and with this value recorded the reference scored reward 1.0 and an empty submission 0.0, natively. Those and the earlier runs are in tests/README.md, section 6. The tree has changed since (the kit of upstream 1c13a47 and a rebuilt probe copy: tests/README.md, section 6, the last entry); the native verify has not been repeated on it yet.
note: mean_pack_credit is the mean over the hidden packs of the value of the components that lie undamaged where they belong over the value of everything in the pack (packcell/rules.py `credit`), already on [0, 1]; ratio = measured / value, reward = clamp(ratio / full_at, 0, 1). full_at 0.95: on the author's machine the reference repeats each pack step for step, so there is no spread to size it from; 0.95 leaves room for what another CPU may do to a contact-rich simulation (a fastener that bounces out of a bin is 0.1 % of the metric, a module that is not racked 1.5 %). It has to be sized again from `ale validate` runs on the evaluation hosts.
